visualCharacteristics.purpose: inline row of footnoted disclosure links (e.g. '1 Important Pricing & Information +') that jump to or expand legal disclosure content

contentPattern.structure: first cell: the disclosure link (an optional superscript footnote number before it); optional second cell: the disclosure content, which the link then toggles open. A link to a /fragments/ page becomes a toggle that loads the fragment; a #hash link scrolls to and opens the matching details element

usage: Use under product hero/offer areas for 'Important Pricing & Information' and 'Additional Information' links. Add dark for light text on a dark section.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any short row of footnote or disclosure toggles. Long legal copy belongs in legal-disclosures; site-wide legal links in legal-links.
